column1: # The M5 forked variant of the incident corpus. THIS FILE IS THE INCIDENT: committed,
# checksum-pinned by the gate, never regenerated by the code it tests. It extends the M4 format
# with the durable branch lifecycle, in the order the incident happened:
# forkc|<session>|<from>|<child>   — a durable fork: one commit on the parent's timeline, then
#                                    the child's standing state is hydrated from the parent's
# rewindc|<session>|<child>        — a durable rewind: recorded, then the state is torn down
# mergec|<session>|<child>|<into>  — the child's post-fork divergence merged into `into`,
#                                    policy re-run per write, all-or-nothing, marker-deduplicated
# The story: sess-a ingests a poisoned page and derives a compromise claim from it. The agent
# forks two hypotheses. hyp-a inherits the poisoned standing state, does clean follow-up work,
# and is merged back; hyp-b is a dead end and is rewound. The account is suspended on the
# strength of the poisoned claim. Then the source is discovered to be a lie, and one taint call
# must heal the parent AND the fork's inherited state, leave the bystander untouched, and lead
# its report with the suspension receipt.
